name: sidebar
description: One sidebar with a tab for each of your mods (Flightdeck, Self Improve, Task View, Idea Shelf and the rest), in the Bottom Bar's colours.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop the Sidebar opening or drawing anything; /sidebar then only says it is off.

startTab.title: Tab it opens on
startTab.description: Which tab the Sidebar shows when it opens: the one you used last, its own Sidebar tab, or a particular mod. Default: last used.

reopenOnStart.title: Reopen at session start
reopenOnStart.description: Reopen the Sidebar in a new session if it was left open last time. Default: on.

showFooter.title: Show the footer
showFooter.description: Show Context's footer (Hindsight, CodeGraph, git, test passes) at the bottom of every tab. Default: on.

showBadges.title: Show tab badges
showBadges.description: Show the number badges other mods put on their tabs. Default: on.
